description: This file defines the interface for managing temporary object directories within a version control system, including creating, migrating, destroying, and adjusting object directories, as well as handling environment variables and process-level integration.

classes.name: struct tmp_objdir
classes.description: Opaque structure representing a temporary object directory used for managing temporary git object storage.

classes.name: struct repository
classes.description: Opaque structure representing a repository context.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_create
methods.description: Creates a new temporary object directory with a specified prefix.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_env
methods.description: Generates environment variables for processes to utilize the temporary object directory.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_migrate
methods.description: Migrates objects from the temporary directory into the main object database.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_destroy
methods.description: Destroys the temporary object directory, discarding its contents.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_discard_objects
methods.description: Removes all objects from the temporary object directory, leaving it intact.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_add_as_alternate
methods.description: Adds the temporary object directory as an alternate object store.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_replace_primary_odb
methods.description: Replaces the primary object database with the temporary object directory, possibly marking it for destruction.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_unapply_primary_odb
methods.description: Restores the original primary object database if it was replaced.

methods.name: tmp_objdir_reapply_primary_odb
methods.description: Reapplies the primary object database configuration with a potentially changed working directory.
